newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries steady as quiet session seen.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries steady as quiet session seen.

text.p: The prices of U.S. Treasury securities were steady at Wednesday's opening following a quiet session of overseas trading.

Traders said activity likely would remain subdued in coming sessions as there was little economic news expected to weigh as heavily on the market as the Employment Cost Index and monthly nonfarm payrolls figures.

Due this session were new housing starts and industrial production and capacity utilization numbers, but analysts expected little significant reaction in the market. Release was set for 0830 EDT/1230 GMT and 0915 EDT/1315 GMT respectively.
